Title: Azure achieves its first PCI 3DS certification

Body.Content:
Today we’re announcing Microsoft Azure has achieved its first PCI 3-D Secure (PCI 3DS) certification.

Azure has partnered with Coalfire, an independent Qualified Security Assessor (QSA), to deliver the following:

  • PCI 3DS Attestation of Compliance (AoC) which includes the full list of PCI 3DS certified Azure offerings and regions.
  • PCI 3DS Shared Responsibility Matrix which defines the nature of responsibility for each PCI 3DS requirement.
  • PCI 3DS Whitepaper which provides specific implementation instruction to customers looking to leverage Azure to support their own PCI 3DS environments.

These documents are available on the Service Trust Portal.
